policyTitle: Corporate Medical Policy: Preferred Injectable Oncology Program
indications: Persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer
Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer

diagnosisRequirements.description: FDA labeled indication for the requested agent and route of administration
diagnosisRequirements.evidenceText: The patient has an FDA labeled indication for the requested agent and route of administration. The requested indication does NOT require genetic/specific diagnostic testing OR if genetic testing is required, both the testing has been performed AND the results indicate therapy with the requested agent is appropriate in FDA labeling.

stepTherapy.failureCriteria: Documented serious adverse event that required medical intervention to both preferred bevacizumab biosimilar products (bevacizumab-awwb [Mvasi], bevacizumab-bvzr [Zirabev]) that is not anticipated with the requested product
stepTherapy.evidenceText: If the request is for bevacizumab (Avastin) or a non-preferred bevacizumab biosimilar product, then both of the following criteria are met: The patient has a documented serious adverse event that required medical intervention to both preferred bevacizumab biosimilar products that is not anticipated with the requested product; AND The prescriber has completed and submitted an FDA MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting Form [medical record documentation required].

otherRequirements.requirement: For bevacizumab (Avastin) or non-preferred biosimilar products, patient must have documented serious adverse event to all preferred biosimilar products and prescriber must submit FDA MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting Form
otherRequirements.evidenceText: If the request is for bevacizumab (Avastin) or a non-preferred bevacizumab biosimilar product (e.g., bevacizumab-maly [Alymsys], bevacizumab-tnjn [Avzivi], bevacizumab-nwgd [Jobevne], bevacizumab-adcd [Vegzelma]), then both of the following criteria are met: a. The patient has a documented serious adverse event that required medical intervention to both preferred bevacizumab biosimilar products (i.e., bevacizumab-awwb [Mvasi], bevacizumab-bvzr [Zirabev]) that is not anticipated with the requested product; AND b. The prescriber has completed and submitted an FDA MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting Form [medical record documentation required].

otherRequirements.requirement: Patient is currently being treated with the requested agent and has been stable on therapy for at least 180 days; OR patient has been treated with the requested agent within the past 180 days AND is at risk if therapy is changed
otherRequirements.evidenceText: ONE of the following: a. The patient is currently being treated with the requested agent and has been stable on therapy for at least 180 days; OR b. The patient has been treated with the requested agent within the past 180 days AND is at risk if therapy is changed.

source.document: BCBS NC - Corporate Medical Policy_ Preferred Injectable Oncology Program (Avastin example).pdf

otherRequirements.requirement: The requested agent will be used as a first-line agent AND is FDA labeled as a first-line agent for the requested indication, OR the patient has used the appropriate number and type(s) of prerequisite agent(s) listed in the FDA labeling
otherRequirements.evidenceText: ONE of the following: i. The requested agent will be used as a first-line agent AND is FDA labeled as a first-line agent for the requested indication, including any genomic aberrations (e.g., EGFR, ALK) and/or tumor expression factors (e.g., PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score [TPS] values); OR ii. The patient has used the appropriate number and type(s) of prerequisite agent(s) listed in the FDA labeling for the requested indication, including any genomic aberrations (e.g., EGFR, ALK) and/or tumor expression factors (e.g., PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score [TPS] values); OR iii. The patient has an intolerance, FDA labeled contraindication, or hypersensitivity to ALL of the required prerequisite agent(s) listed in the FDA labeling for the requested indication.

source.section: Criteria for Medical Necessity - Initial Criteria for Approval - 2(b)

otherRequirements.requirement: The requested agent is being used as monotherapy AND is approved for use as monotherapy in the FDA labeling OR the requested agent will be used in combination as combination therapy with all agent(s) and/or treatments listed for concomitant use in the FDA labeling
otherRequirements.evidenceText: ONE of the following: i. The requested agent is being used as monotherapy AND is approved for use as monotherapy in the FDA labeling for the requested indication, including any genomic aberrations (e.g., EGFR, ALK) and/or tumor expression factors (e.g., PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score [TPS] values); OR ii. The requested agent will be used in combination as combination therapy with all agent(s) and/or treatments (e.g., radiation) listed for concomitant use in the FDA labeling for the requested indication.

otherRequirements.requirement: The FDA label does NOT include a performance status requirement; OR The patient meets the performance status requirement in the FDA labeling
otherRequirements.evidenceText: ONE of the following: i. The FDA label does NOT include a performance status requirement; OR ii. The patient meets the performance status requirement in the FDA labeling.
